Bone_Crushing_Jaw_Maw.description: The Bone_Crushing_Jaw_Maw is a fearsome gnash of jagged, obsidian teeth set in a powerful, snapping maw, capable of crushing bones to dust with a single bite, its inner flesh secreting a glue-like substance that binds prey tighter with each struggle.

Disease_Drool_Maw.description: The Disease_Drool_Maw is a grotesque, gaping maw filled with razor-sharp teeth, constantly slick with a viscous, greenish drool that bubbles ominously. Its surface is cold and clammy to the touch, and when it opens to unleash a venomous bite, a noxious cloud of disease-laden spittle sprays forth, spreading sickness and decay in its wake.

Cackling_Screech_Maw.description: The Cackling_Screech_Maw is a grotesque, gaping mouth filled with jagged, yellowed fangs that seem to stretch endlessly into a cavernous throat, its constant, eerie laughter echoing like the wind through abandoned ruins, filling the air with dread and foreboding.

Pack_Call_Maw.description: The Pack_Call_Maw is a grotesque, gaping mouth adorned with razor-sharp teeth that seem to whisper ancient secrets of the pack, its warm breath carrying a haunting melody that compels hyenids to unite and follow.

Venomous_Saliva_Maw.description: The Venomous_Saliva_Maw is a grotesque appendage, dripping with a viscous, emerald-green saliva that hisses and sizzles upon contact with air, capable of injecting potent toxins with a mere snap of its razor-sharp, serrated teeth.

Aardwolf_Insectivore_Maw.description: The Aardwolf Insectivore Maw is a cavernous, darkened orifice lined with sharp, interlocking teeth designed to snare and devour swarms of insects, its rough tongue flicking out with the precision of a predator's claw to snatch prey from the air or ground, leaving opponents wary of its sudden, darting movements.

Undead_Rotting_Maw.description: The Undead_Rotting_Maw is a decaying, gnashing mouth set in a skull-riddled head, its teeth jagged and dripping with a noxious venom that sickens all who dare to taste its bite, while the very air around it churns with an aura of dread and despair.

Giant_Cave_Crushing_Maw.description: The Giant Cave Crushing Maw is a gaping, obsidian-black orifice lined with razor-sharp, serrated teeth that gleam with a malevolent, inner light, capable of crushing stone and flesh alike with a single, powerful snap. Its iron grip is unyielding, and the cavernous interior is lined with barbs that catch and tear at anything foolish enough to enter, leaving only bones behind.

Acid_Spitting_Maw.description: The Acid_Spitting_Maw is a grotesque, gaping orifice lined with serrated, blackened teeth that glisten with traces of corrosive acid. Whenever it opens to emit a spurt of caustic liquid, the air hisses and sizzles around it, leaving a lingering stench of decay and danger.

Serrated_Hyena_Maw.description: The Serrated_Hyena_Maw, a fearsome relic of the Underworld's savannahs, is a jagged, bloodstained mouthpiece with razor-sharp teeth that gleam with an unnatural, predatory sheen. Its presence fills the air with a chill of impending doom and the tactile sensation of cold, relentless hunger.

Night_Stalker_Maw.description: The Night_Stalker_Maw is a gaping cavity lined with razor-sharp fangs that gleam with a sinister, phosphorescent glow in the dark, its cold breath carrying whispers of impending doom. When closed, it feels like a dense, cold void, enhancing the user's ability to blend into shadows while granting them formidable biting strength and the eerie ability to strike without warning.

Blood_Frenzy_Frothy_Maw.description: The Blood_Frenzy_Frothy_Maw is a gnarled and twisted mouthpiece, its razor-sharp teeth stained dark with dried blood, exuding an aura of rabid hunger that can trigger a primal, blood-laden rage in its wielder. When activated, it emits a guttural growl and saliva foams at the edges, enhancing physical strength while eroding the user's self-control and charisma.
